definitions.explanation: The general category of leguminous plants and their edible seeds, including soybeans, azuki beans, lentils, and other varieties.

⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食文化|しょくぶんか}→食文化：29223_shokubunka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{大豆|だいず}→大豆：10536_daizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はじめ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{豆類|まめるい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: In Japanese food culture, legumes — especially soybeans — are indispensable.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧ (bean) and ⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧ (kind, category). The standard collective term for beans and legumes, commonly used in nutrition, cooking, and agriculture contexts.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{豆類|まめるい} are central to Japanese cuisine. ⟦{大豆|だいず}→大豆：10536_daizu⟧ (soybeans) alone form the basis for ⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧, ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧, ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧, ⟦{納豆|なっとう}→納豆：04930_nattou⟧, and ⟦{枝豆|えだまめ}→枝豆：21197_edamame⟧. ⟦{小豆|あずき}→小豆：10209_azuki⟧ (azuki beans) are essential for traditional sweets.
